ov: Insects whose front wings are hardened into wing-cases. With about 400,000 described species, beetles are the largest order of insects, found in almost every habitat except the sea and the polar regions.

why.h: About 90% of beetle species go through a dormant stage as adults, and in winter this is a form of hibernation.
why.et: Over 300 species are eaten, mostly as larvae, such as mealworms and rhinoceros beetle grubs.
why.p: Some are kept as pets, such as diving beetles in a home freshwater tank.

rg: Almost every habitat worldwide, except the sea and the polar regions.
df: Varies: plants, fungi, decaying matter and other invertebrates. Ladybirds eat aphids.
fx: Estimates of the true number of beetle species run from 0.9 to 2.1 million.
